added: Plugin SDK APIs for identity-bound configuration, selective encryption, host events, status capsules, floating panels, and desktop-backed local tunnels.
breaking: Pi Desk settings and participating plugins now use unified YAML configuration. Legacy files are retained but are not migrated or read as a fallback. Remote-debug profiles must be recreated in `.pi/pi-desk.yaml` instead of `.pi/remote_debug.yaml`. Native Pi configuration remains unchanged.
Desktop configuration no longer migrates legacy per-target tunnel settings; documents without the current targets structure are rejected.
Plugin configuration encryption and decryption paths now use options objects; the old path-array calling convention is no longer supported.
changed: The chat composer has updated send/stop controls and a more adaptive layout. Model switching is available when only background tasks are running.
Model selections and presets are stored separately from native model definitions. Removing a model from the collection no longer changes project defaults.
features: Back up and restore environments using password-encrypted archives, with optional sessions and plugin data, import previews, item selection, directory remapping, and overwrite confirmation.
Plugin configuration supports project-level overrides layered over global settings and defaults.
Task status capsules show running activity and provide quick access to task details.
Remote-debug tasks automatically open desktop-local gateway mappings and release them when tasks end.
Desktop and plugin configuration support encrypted sensitive values backed by system-managed keys. Restored configuration is re-encrypted for the destination environment.
fixed: Expanding messages, tool details, or thinking panels no longer interrupts automatic scrolling at the bottom of a conversation.
Stopping while a message is being prepared or submitted safely handles the send/stop race, restoring unsent content to the draft when appropriate.
Pasted screenshots retain their original image data even if a later screenshot replaces the clipboard's temporary file.
Plugin installation prechecks inherit npm configuration and lockfile state, and dependency downloads respect the selected public registry.
